Name: DisplayEnergy
Author: dmarcoux
Description:
[i]DisplayEnergy[/i] is a [url=https://www.stardewvalley.net/][i]Stardew Valley[/i][/url] mod built with [url=https://smapi.io/][i]SMAPI[/i][/url] mod to permanently display the player's current and max energy.

This mod supports split-screen and the position of the energy text is customizable in-game when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is installed.

[b][size=4]How to Install This Mod[/size][/b]

Refer to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide][i]SMAPI[/i] player guide[/url] to learn how to install [i]SMAPI[/i] mods.

This mod is available on [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1087175-displayenergy]ModDrop[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10662]NexusMods[/url].

[b][size=4]Acknowledgements
[/size][/b]
[i]DisplayEnergy[/i] was based off the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4272]EnergyCount[/url] mod, thank you [i]Crystallyne[/i] for creating that mod. I decided to create [i]DisplayEnergy[/i] when I realized [i]EnergyCount [/i]didn't support split-screen. Later on, I made the position of the energy text customizable.

[b][size=4]Source Code[/size][/b]

This mod is open-source at [url=https://github.com/dmarcoux/DisplayEnergy]https://github.com/dmarcoux/DisplayEnergy[/url].
